verdict.rationale: Mollie publishes a full llms.txt page index at docs.mollie.com/llms.txt, and a live probe confirmed it returns HTTP 200. The docs also state that appending .md to any page URL returns a markdown version, which is why every cited doc URL resolves as .md, so an agent can discover pages and fetch clean markdown. Missing for 10: no evidence of a single-file full-docs dump (e.g. llms-full.txt) or a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed OpenAPI paths returned 404).
